title: Notes on the Thirsting
author: Brother Ansric, of the Brands
pages: The Thirsting are not beasts. They are people who were dying, and someone offered them a cup. They drank. Now they must drink again every few nights, from the living and from their sleep.
Signs: sleepers in one house waking pale, weak and dreamless. Mirrors in a stranger's lodging turned to the wall. A lodger who will not cross a lit threshold unless invited by name.
They lose their names slowly. Ask their mother's name and they will hesitate. Ask their own, and some will weep. That is when you know, and that is when you must be kind before you are just.
Kindle your threshold and they cannot pass it uninvited. Daylight burns them. A Sunjudge or a Flamekeeper can try them. Many want to be caught. They are tired of being thirsty.
And find the cup. Somewhere is the one who offered it and did not drink. That is the true monster, and it is never the one at your window. Follow the Thirsting home.
